items.t: A club, far too loud. {1} is going under. {3} has already cleared a path to the exit. {2} is holding the headphones out before anyone has asked.
{1} has stepped on a squeaky floorboard and recoiled. Everyone else has stopped dead and is staring.
{1} is explaining something at length to people who are absolutely not listening. {1} has not noticed.
Everyone playing a game very badly. Nobody is winning. Somebody is blaming the controller.
Far too much shopping. The situation is deteriorating. {3} is the only reason it has not collapsed.
Deep jungle, treated with mild administrative irritation, as though it were an inconvenient shift.
Standing on an alien planet in ordinary clothes, unimpressed, one of them checking the time.
Kitchen table. Three unrelated tasks in progress, all abandoned mid step.
{2} is covered in cat hair and has made peace with it. {4} is unrepentant.
{3} is fixing a problem nobody else has registered, and has not mentioned it.
{1} is apologising for something that did not happen. Everyone else has heard this before.
Coat half on, keys in hand, leaving, delayed by one more thing.
{1}'s battery bank is plugged into somebody else's phone. Nobody remembers agreeing to this.
{4} has seen something. Nobody else has any idea what.
